record.body:
## Interfaces

close-batch keeps the same close-request JSON and NDJSON apply-batch shape; on done it loads check_run_id / red_check_run_id via aa.get (store from process cwd / optional store_root, --cwd for ancestry only), matches criterion_id/result/(runner|revision when present), runs red-first from store payloads, and still skips check-run creates for tdd/check. aff check unchanged in this diff: --cwd pins work HEAD, store from Path.cwd(); timeout→blocked and empty verify_command refuse already in product path; new primary+linked-worktree tests cover R5/R6.

## Assumptions

Store remains discoverable from the primary checkout the same way aff check writes it; verify-work continues to pass real check_run_ids rather than hand-writing runner check-runs; injectable load_check_run is test-only and production CLI uses default_load_check_run.

## Invariants

Agent-typed pass/fail cannot close tdd/check done without a store-resident runner check-run (runner==aff) whose criterion_id/result/(revision when copied) match; red/green ancestry uses store revisions (dirty red via store diff_sha256); spikes/ not imported by product code; manual check-runs still agent-created via the batch.

## Conflicts

None observed with the stated non-goals (no oracle/thin-acceptance/phase-end, no ancestry rule rewrite beyond store-backing, no contract/runtime extension change). Spec R1's absolute "match revision/runner" is implemented as store runner marker plus pairwise match when the request carries those fields, which matches the design/check-method revision ban.
